# sophosfirewall_country_group (Resource)

Manages a country group (*Objects > Hosts and services > Country group*). Country groups can be referenced from firewall and NAT rules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sophosfirewall_country_group" "blocked" {
  name        = "blocked-countries"
  description = "Countries we never accept traffic from"
  countries   = ["North Korea", "Iran"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the country group.

### Optional

- `countries` (Set of String) Names of the countries in the group, as known to the firewall.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by name or UUID.
terraform import sophosfirewall_country_group.example <name-or-uuid>
```
